name: Grab Plate Then Pose Sequence
description: Grip a wellplate with the right arm at hold_plate and hold it in place, then run the left arm through the captured left_arm_pose_sequence_1 trajectory. Right arm is never touched by the sequence step.
author: zeon

nodes.label: Hold Plate Down
nodes.description: Grip the plate at its 'hold_plate' anchor with the right arm and hold it in place — no lift, no retract.

nodes.label: Left Arm Pose Sequence 1
nodes.description: Run the left arm through the captured 10-waypoint trajectory. Never touches the right arm, so the plate hold is undisturbed.
